Copied each flagged file through `tr -d '\r'` into a scratch tree and re-ran gofmt -> 55 files still fail. Both numbers match the finding EXACTLY. .golangci.yml enables only errcheck, staticcheck, ineffassign, unused — no formatter. `grep -n 'gofmt|gofumpt' .github/workflows/ci.yml daemon/.golangci.yml` -> no matches.

findings.title: Two real internal packages ship with no test files at all
findings.verification: Directory listing: internal/freshness contains only freshness.go; internal/pairsstudy contains only pairsstudy.go and result.json. No _test.go in either.

findings.title: No fuzz targets and no benchmarks anywhere in the daemon
findings.verification: `grep -rh '^func Fuzz' --include='*_test.go' daemon/ | wc -l` -> 0. `grep -rh '^func Benchmark' --include='*_test.go' daemon/ | wc -l` -> 0.

escalations.one_line: 859 score_outcomes at 1d carry a forward return stamped before the forward window closed; ResolveOutcome has no elapsed-horizon guard so the class can recur. prediction_outcomes is clean, which is what keeps it off the published accuracy path.

archivePruneDerived's cut==0 branch prunes ts<=maxTs while archiving only the first archiveBatch rows — permanent loss of un-archived rows if any single timestamp ever exceeds 50,000 rows. Headroom today is 16x (3,144).

riskgate.Admit fails CLOSED only on equity; an unmeasurable drawdown, daily P&L, gross exposure or correlation leaves that breaker unarmed and ALLOWS the trade. GrossKnown is cleared by a single unmarked position.

The kill switch has no HTTP/CLI trigger or readback, resolves ops/HALT against the process cwd, and the launchd plist anchors that cwd at signaldeck/daemon — an operator following the macOS runbook would touch a file the daemon never reads, with no error.

4,583 graded predictions (1.19%) are absent from the tamper-evident hash chain and 335 chain identities are duplicated; the append is best-effort by design, so the gap is architectural and not exactly reconstructable.

1,868 of 2,950 symbols are simultaneously active=1 and delisted, 3,898 (day,symbol) pairs carry 1d bars dated after their symbol's delisting, and one such artifact ticker aborts the whole universe-poller batch.

2 of the 16 closed round trips in the published flagship-1d win rate and expectancy are ~7e-15-dollar dust fills counted at full weight, and 16 paper_equity marks carry negative cash against a stated never-negative invariant.

not_proven: No claim here rests on a green test alone. Coverage (idx 26) is the one place a test run IS the evidence, and its CI-platform outcome is explicitly left UNVERIFIED.
The Cf-Connecting-Ip bypass (idx 5) was NOT reproduced — no tunnel to :8322 was started.
The kill switch (idx 9) was NOT tripped.
The 13:10 PT outage (idx 3) was NOT re-observed live; it is attributed from the scripts plus today's backup artifact.
The horizon-drift MAGNITUDE (idx 24) was not measured, only the mechanism.
Whether the regime_outcome_error burst (idx 23) was fixed or silenced was not determined.
Heavy scans ran against the 13:10 PT backup, not the live file, so counts drift by hours against the live DB. Every count reconciles with the original finding to within that window.
